description: Authoritative GNSS reacquisition and candidate fix screening phase enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 Component C-09 and Interface I-15.

definitions.IDLE: No outage recovery in progress; normal tracking or continuous GNSS outage.
definitions.SCREENING: Candidate GNSS fix observed post-outage; evaluating kinematic plausibility and innovation bounds.
definitions.DWELL: Consecutive plausible fixes accumulating to satisfy dwell time and innovation variance stability criteria.
definitions.ACCEPTED: Reacquisition validation complete; candidate fixes accepted for filter measurement updates.
definitions.REJECTED: Candidate fixes failed screening, dwell consistency, or innovation gate; reacquisition aborted.
